artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a positive integer n, let $H_n = \sum_{k=1}^{n} \tfrac{1}{k}$ denote the n-th harmonic number, and let $B_n$ denote the n-th Bernoulli number (defined by the generating function $\tfrac{x}{e^x-1} = \sum_{n\ge 0} B_n \tfrac{x^n}{n!}$). Prove or disprove the following congruences for primes p.

(i) For every prime $p > 7$,
$$\sum_{k=1}^{p-1} \frac{\binom{2k}{k}}{k^3} \equiv -\frac{2}{p^2} H_{p-1} - 13 \sum_{k=1}^{p-1} \frac{1}{k^3} \pmod{p^4}.$$

(ii) For every prime $p > 5$,
$$\frac{1}{p^3}\!\left(\sum_{k=1}^{p-1} \frac{k^4}{\binom{2k}{k}} - H_{p-1}\right) \equiv \frac{7}{54 p}\sum_{k=1}^{p-1} \frac{1}{k^3} \equiv -\frac{7}{45} p\, B_{p-5} \pmod{p^2}.$$

(iii) For every prime $p > 5$,
$$\sum_{k=1}^{(p-1)/2} \frac{(-1)^k}{k^3 \binom{2k}{k}} \equiv -2 B_{p-3} \pmod{p}.$$

(iv) For every prime $p > 5$,
$$\sum_{k=1}^{(p-1)/2} \frac{(-1)^k}{k^2 \binom{2k}{k}} \equiv \frac{56}{15} p\, B_{p-3} \pmod{p^2}.$$

(v) For every prime $p > 5$,
$$\sum_{p/2 < k < p} \frac{\binom{2k}{k}^2}{k\,16^k} \equiv -\frac{21}{2}\, H_{p-1} \pmod{p^4}.$$

Determine whether each of these congruences holds for all sufficiently large primes p as stated.
